text: Ɓen Suuɗooɓe kon ko Allah Jippini ka Deftere e ko woni e mayre immorde e daliluuji selluɗi, e fii annabaaku Muhammadu (yo o his), wano alyahuuda e annasaara en gerdata; hiɓe soodira ngol suuɗugol maɓɓe ɗon cogguwel famɗungel; wano fii ardagol maa jaahu maa jawdi. Ɓen ɗon alaa e waɗude ka deedi maɓɓe ka haqiiqa, si wanaa kon leñtoyta ɓe ka yiite, Allah Yeewtoytaa ɓe ñalnde darngal ko ɓe yiɗi, ko woni, O yeewtoyayɓe ko bonaŋta ɓe, O Laɓɓinoytaaɓe O Maŋtoytaaɓe, hino woodani ɓe lepte muusuɗe.
